title: CandidateClaim
description: Capture output only: a claim as extracted by a capture component, never a final reviewed claim. The enumerable derivation marker is required so privacy decisions survive JSON, filesystem, CLI, and MCP boundaries. raw_body and mixed derivations are never portable. suggested_kind is optional, classification_method is always 'keyword', review_status is always 'unreviewed', provenance is carried in canonical structured source_refs, and the claim must not carry a final kind field. Reviewed claims are represented by Claim (claim.schema.json).

id.description: Stable candidate identifier within the capture run.

suggested_kind.description: Optional keyword-classified suggestion (fact, blocker, risk, unknown). Never authoritative.

classification_method.description: How the candidate was extracted and classified.

review_status.description: Candidate review state. Extraction emits unreviewed; approved_for_portable and rejected are explicit review decisions.

reviewed_by.description: Non-authenticated reviewer attribution for an approved or rejected candidate.

reviewed_at.description: RFC3339 time supplied with the review decision.

source_refs.description: Canonical structured provenance references captured at extraction time.

source_material.description: Material class from which the candidate was derived; raw_body and mixed are not portable.
